o.text:
Inherited from Proto-Common Turkic *yāt (“alien, foreign, unfamiliar”). Cognate with Bashkir ят (yat), Kazakh жат (jat),
Uzbek yot (“alien, foreign”), Turkmen ýat etc.
Inherited from Proto-Turkic *tōl-. Cognate with Turkish dolmak (“to be full”).
Morphologically, from çağır- (“to call”) + -ış. The military sense is a semantic loan from Russian призы́в (prizýv). The sense 'parliamentary term' is a semantic loan from Russian созы́в (sozýv).
